=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/cost_audit.py:75 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `SEMBLE_FIELD_RE` line is indented with a literal tab while the rest of the file uses spaces.
  WHY: The module still parses, but reviewers consistently flagged the mixed indentation as a lint/CI hazard; severity was disputed from high to critical.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:71-75 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `file=` field is parsed but still ignored by the bucket logic, so fallback lines can be misclassified.
  WHY: This is a single-reviewer finding, but it points at a real path where `file=` is accepted without changing how entries are bucketed.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:119-130 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `ISSUE_META_FILE` is cleared when the path is outside `RUNTIME_DIR`, but the script does not log that it happened.
  WHY: The guard intentionally fail-opens to live API calls, but it does so silently, so operators cannot tell why cached metadata disappeared.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:263-321 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Missing or unreadable input files are skipped without surfacing an error.
  WHY: The built query can lose expected context when files are absent, which can degrade Semble recall.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:263-321 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The query builder only keeps the first 80 lines of each input file.
  WHY: Long traces can lose identifiers and paths beyond that cap, reducing the quality of the generated Semble query.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:19-28 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `emit_semble_prefetch()` reads and emits the entire prefetch file without a size check.
  WHY: An unexpectedly large file can bloat the rendered prompt.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:137 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_QUERY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS=16000` may truncate complex plan text too aggressively.
  WHY: Relevant file paths or implementation details can be lost before Semble sees the query.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:296-308 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_bounded_query_text()` counts characters, not bytes.
  WHY: Multi-byte UTF-8 text can exceed byte-based subprocess limits even when the character limit is respected.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:305-307 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The truncation can cut text mid-word or mid-path.
  WHY: Splitting identifiers or paths reduces query quality.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:321-363 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `query_text` is passed directly as a command-line argument to the subprocess.
  WHY: Very long queries can still hit argv-related failures even if the text is otherwise bounded.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:337-345 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The query-text path can still proceed with empty or malformed `query_text` after sanitization.
  WHY: This reviewer reports that the guard is insufficient, although deepseek says the explicit empty-string return is already present.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:567 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `marker_only` summary count excludes `semble` and `read_fallback`.
  WHY: That omission can make the rendered summary misreport what was actually emitted.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:316 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Python heredoc skips missing or unreadable input files instead of surfacing an error
  WHY: Empty Semble query text when files are unavailable, degrading the intended context enrichment
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:318 | confidence=4

  WHY: Long stack traces lose relevant identifiers and paths needed for effective Semble recall
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:19-28 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: emit_semble_prefetch() reads the entire prefetch file without size or content validation
  WHY: Oversized or malformed prefetch content can bloat rendered prompts
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:137 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_QUERY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS=16000 may truncate complex plan text too aggressively
  WHY: Loss of important file paths or implementation details before Semble processes the query
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:296-308 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _bounded_query_text() counts characters, not bytes - multi-byte UTF-8 text can exceed byte limits

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/cost_audit.py:75 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The regex line uses a literal tab character for indentation while the rest of the file uses 4-space indentation.
  WHY: Mixed tabs and spaces are a real lint/style violation and reviewers disagreed on runtime severity, with one calling it critical and others high.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:119-130 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: ISSUE_META_FILE path sanitization clears the variable silently when path is outside RUNTIME_DIR.
  WHY: The script falls back to slower API calls without operator visibility.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:263-321 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The build_post_codex_semble_query function skips missing/unreadable files with `continue` and only reads first 80 lines.
  WHY: It silently ignores file errors and truncates long stack traces, potentially losing relevant identifiers.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:20-27 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: emit_semble_prefetch() reads entire SEMBLE_PREFETCH_FILE without size validation.
  WHY: There is no protection against unexpectedly large prefetch files bloating the prompt.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:296-307 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _bounded_query_text() uses len() which counts characters, not bytes.
  WHY: UTF-8 multi-byte characters can cause the actual byte payload to exceed limits even when character count is under 16000.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:305 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Truncation uses simple slicing `stripped[:SEMBLE_QUERY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS]`.
  WHY: It can cut text mid-word or mid-path, potentially breaking identifier matching.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/cost_audit.py | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: line 75 (SEMble_FIELD_RE definition) is indented with a tab character while the file uses spaces.

- scripts/render_prompt.sh | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: lines 20-27 (emit_semble_prefetch function) read and emit the entire SEMBLE_PREFETCH_FILE without a size check or line limits.
  WHY: An oversized or malformed prefetch file can bloat the rendered prompt, hit token limits, or corrupt prompt structure.

  WHY: Semble subprocess failures can force fallback, and the wrong summary can mislead the model/editor.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: lines 123-219 (build_post_codex_semble_query Python heredoc) limit input to first 80 lines per file and skip empty/missing files silently.
  WHY: Long traces/diffs lose key details, and empty query_text skips Semble context entirely.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: lines 119-130 (ISSUE_META_FILE sanitization) silently clears ISSUE_META_FILE on path mismatch without log/metric.
  WHY: The workflow falls back to costly/live API calls repeatedly without observability.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: lines 337-345 (append_post_codex_semble_block query_text check) proceed with empty/malformed query_text after `_semble_sanitize_one_line`.
  WHY: This wastes Semble query/index resources on zero-value input.
- scripts/cost_audit.py | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: lines 71-75 (SEMBLE_FIELD_RE) parse `file=` but `_semble_bucket` ignores it and there is no test coverage for that path.
  WHY: Fallback lines with `file=` but no target/phase can be misclassified.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
